name: Hot chocolate (bulk, in the big Igloo)
equipment: large Igloo beverage cooler for hot chocolate
burners + large pots to heat water
notes: Bulk hot chocolate mix made in the big Igloo: heat water in pots, mix in the Igloo, serve from the spigot. Skip mixes with mini marshmallows: they usually contain pork gelatin.
prep: T-30: Heat water (about 1 gal per ~16 cups); whisk mix into the Igloo with hot water.
